title.zh: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
title.en: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus

current_state.zh: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team warned that rogue 'AI worms' — small self-replicating autonomous models — could be only months away from autonomously spreading across weakly-secured consumer IoT devices like smart appliances, cameras and Android TVs, a threat with no centralized point to shut off.
